synthesis.paragraph: Today, Carlos Moreno and Zaheer Allam's 2021 paper on the 15-minute city, Alessia Calafiore and Richard Dunning's 2021 equity analysis of Liverpool, and Luis A. Guzmán and Daniel Oviedo's 2024 critical analysis of proximity were each cited by 2 papers. A paper on land development intensity in China's high-speed railway station areas shares 17 references with a June 15, 2026, paper on land-use functional patterns, including shared references to works on transit accessibility valuation, Korean high-speed rail stations, and the spatial spillover effects of Chinese high-speed railway stations. Additionally, a paper on perceiving the "city of proximity" shares 12 references with a July 2, 2026, paper on multimodal accessibility in Singapore, and another 12 references with a July 10, 2026, review of the built environment and subjective well-being. Over the last 30 days, Tongji University has appeared on 30 papers, Hong Kong Polytechnic University on 24 papers, and both Peking University and the University of Hong Kong on 20 papers.
